notes: Cross-verse consistency with PSA.78.15. Both verses render a hiphil wayyiqtol that carries no object suffix by an ASV causative or light verb with a supplied object pronoun inside it; 78.15 marks that pronoun added while 78.28 folded it into the verb's unit. No morpheme in 78.28 licenses the it, so it becomes its own added unit under rule 30 and the verb's unit is discontinuous around it under rule 25. Nothing else in the verse changes.
